newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down as investors stay out.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down as investors stay out.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Friday as investors remained on the sidelines because of the country's economic worries and are likely to remain under pressure in the coming weeks, dealers said.

"Investors and institutions are continuously out of the ring. Only speculators are active in a handful of stocks," dealer Ali Asghar said. "Investors lack confidence because of Pakistan's weak economic fundamentals."
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 4.85 points, or 0.31 percent, to end at 1,547.95. Losers led gainers 161 to 69.
